market.question: Will the highest temperature in Buenos Aires be 23°C on May 1?

assessment.reasoning: Buenos Aires May 1 forecast high ~19.1°C. Question asks for 23°C exact bin (23.0-23.9°C). 23°C is 4°C above forecast - warm tail. Possible if a warm air mass advances from north, but unlikely. Probability ~0.08-0.12.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Argentine northerlies (sudestada or norte wind) can boost temperatures; otherwise cool autumn pattern.
